svg.title: ClassIQ architecture
svg.desc: Pipeline: Raspberry Pi 5 recorder, Express 5 API with Socket.IO, speech-to-text for Indian languages, LLM bilingual quizzes, PostgreSQL with BullMQ jobs, Next.js PWA for admin, teacher and student.
